# Release 1.20 — Modular monolith foundations

**Status:** Outline — freeze when 1.19 ships (may start design/spike earlier; do not merge scope into frozen 1.2–1.19 files)  
**Milestone:** `1.20`  
**Parent strategy:** [Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md](../Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md)  
**Architecture source of truth:** [../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md](../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md)  
**Rule:** Do not edit this file to mark done or change scope after `Approved for freeze`. Status → GitHub milestone/issues only.

---

## Outcome

Wealth Orbit remains a **single local deployable** (FastAPI + React) but gains **hard internal module boundaries** so Portfolio, Market Research, Sync, Stance (later), Strategy Lab (later), and Agentic Chat (later) can evolve independently. Private vs shared data ownership is explicit. Empty “microservice” directories are **not** turned into real services in this release.

This release is the structural prerequisite for daily decision loops and buy/hold/avoid (1.22–1.27). It does **not** ship stance labels or watchlists by itself.

---

## Locked decisions (do not reopen without a new release)

| Decision | Choice | Rationale for future agents |
|----------|--------|------------------------------|
| Topology | **Modular monolith**, not microservices | Personal-first, free/minimal cost; empty dirs (`market-data-service/`, `strategy-engine/`, etc.) stay placeholders |
| Deployable | One process: `uvicorn backend_api.app.main:app` serving `/api/v1` + `/ui/` | Matches today’s ops; avoids multi-service free-tier/ops cost |
| Private store | SQLite portfolio/users (`PORTFOLIO_SQLITE_URL`) | User secrets and ledger stay off shared cloud DB |
| Shared store | Supabase Postgres `market_data` (`DATABASE_URL`, session pooler) | Shared India research catalog |
| Multi-user later | Same module contracts; private schemas migrate later | APIs must already accept `user_id` / portfolio context even in personal mode |
| UI surface | React is the product UI; Streamlit is legacy | Do not add new Streamlit features in 1.20+ |
| Live trading | **Forbidden** through at least 1.27 | No broker order placement |
| SEBI / advisory law | Out of band for engineering releases | Do not block 1.20 on legal design |

---

## Target module map (normative)

```text
React UI
  → FastAPI thin HTTP routes
      → Portfolio          → SQLite (private)
      → MarketResearch     → Postgres market_data (shared)
      → Sync/Ingestion     → Postgres writers + job queue
      → StanceEngine       → (stub/package boundary only in 1.20; logic in 1.23+)
      → StrategyLab        → (boundary only; logic remains 1.14–1.17 / 1.25)
      → AgenticChat        → (boundary only; logic 1.18–1.19 / 1.27)
```

### Ownership rules

| Module | Owns | Must not own |
|--------|------|----------------|
| Portfolio | users, auth session coupling, txs, holdings, MTM/XIRR/reports (when those releases land), watchlists (1.22) | Scraping, OHLC upserts, stance scoring formulas |
| MarketResearch | masters, prices/NAV reads, fundamentals/technicals reads, screener snapshots | Buy/hold/avoid wording, user ledger |
| Sync/Ingestion | providers, `sync_jobs`, retention hooks, quota probes (hooks consumed by 1.21) | UI copy, stance labels |
| StanceEngine | Package + interface stub in 1.20; full L1 in 1.23 | Raw HTTP scraping |
| StrategyLab | Discovery/run boundaries aligned with screen/strategy plugins | Portfolio mutations |
| AgenticChat | Chat route boundary only | Inventing metrics or labels |

---

## Foundation

- [ ] Document module ownership in-repo (this file + short pointer from `docs/setup.md` or architecture note) so agents do not invent a microservice split
- [ ] Introduce clear Python package/module layout (or documented folders) for Portfolio, MarketResearch, Sync — without requiring a rename of `portfolio-service` in this release if too costly; **if** hyphen package shim remains, confine it to one compatibility module
- [ ] Thin `market_data_routes.py` / portfolio routes: routes validate + call module services; no provider scrape logic in route handlers
- [ ] All new Portfolio/Stance-facing APIs accept authenticated user context where data is user-scoped
- [ ] Do not create real services under empty top-level placeholder directories
- [ ] Connection access for Postgres goes through a **single** data-access helper (pooling lands fully in 1.21; 1.20 at least stops adding new one-off `psycopg2.connect` call sites)

---

## Backlog

### Structure

- [ ] Define module entrypoints (e.g. `portfolio_service`, `market_research`, `sync_ingestion` — exact names may match existing trees but must be listed in the PR)
- [ ] Move or wrap fat query logic currently concentrated in `reference_service.py` behind MarketResearch APIs used by routes (incremental allowed; no big-bang rewrite required if interfaces are clear)
- [ ] Keep `sync_queue.py` as Sync module; document that max_workers and job table ownership belong to Sync
- [ ] Add empty/stub StanceEngine module with a documented interface contract (see 1.23 for full schema); 1.20 may return `501`/`not implemented` for stance routes if exposed early — prefer **not** exposing public stance routes until 1.23

### Multi-user readiness (soft)

- [ ] User-scoped tables/APIs consistently key by `user_id` / `portfolio_id`
- [ ] No new “global mutable user preference” stored only in process memory without DB backing

### Docs / agent guardrails

- [ ] Update operator docs: “modular monolith; do not split services for personal phase”
- [ ] Mark Streamlit as legacy in frontend README if still claiming primary UI
- [ ] Cross-link this release from the architecture evaluation spec §7.2

### Tests

- [ ] Smoke: app boots; `/api/v1` health or auth status; React still served
- [ ] At least one Portfolio and one MarketResearch service function covered by unit or API test proving routes do not embed provider I/O

---

## Out of scope

- Microservice extraction, Docker Compose multi-service mesh, K8s  
- Stance Buy/Hold/Avoid computation (1.23+)  
- Watchlists / morning inbox UI (1.22)  
- Storage Tier S/A/B policy enforcement and quota probes (1.21) — **except** not adding anti-patterns that block 1.21  
- Strategy Lab product UI, backtests (1.14–1.17)  
- Glossary/agentic chat product work (1.18–1.19, 1.27)  
- Live trading, broker order APIs  
- TimescaleDB  
- SEBI/compliance workflows  

---

## Exit

An engineer or agent can point to named modules with ownership tables; HTTP routes are thin; Sync/Portfolio/Market boundaries are documented; no new microservice deployables; personal app still runs on one uvicorn process.

---

## Agent planning instructions (normative for future plans)

When writing an implementation plan for 1.20:

1. **Read** the architecture evaluation design and this file before proposing file moves.  
2. **Prefer** incremental extraction (facade over `reference_service`) over a risky rewrite in one PR.  
3. **Refuse** plans that “stand up FastAPI services per empty folder.”  
4. **Refuse** plans that put stance scoring or LLM calls in this release.  
5. Keep free/minimal cost: no Redis/Kafka/extra hosted services required for 1.20.  
6. If a change would break Alembic/`DATABASE_URL` session-pooler rules from 1.3, stop and align with 1.3.  
7. Open GitHub issues as one issue per Foundation/Backlog checkbox; milestone `1.20`.  
8. Validate then ship before starting 1.21 scope merge into the same PR train.
